legal_notice_service_description: Vennett is a paper-strategy platform. It is free and has no advertising.
legal_notice_ip_text: The design, code, and text belong to their owner. Company and index names (such as “S&P 500”) belong to their respective owners and are used only to identify them. Each person retains their content; see the
legal_terms_summary_1: Vennett compares paper strategies: no real money is invested, and nothing is a recommendation to buy or sell.
legal_terms_summary_2: Vennett charges nothing: there are no paid plans or in-app purchases.
legal_terms_summary_3: You can delete your account at any time.
legal_terms_paper_platform: A paper-strategy platform: you choose rules from a catalog and compare their performance each month with the S&P 500 and other people's methods. League points summarize the comparison at the close of each round.
legal_terms_no_advice: Vennett does not provide financial advice or manage real money. No strategy, whether created by a person or by the house (Alpha, Omega, Lambda), is an investment recommendation. “S&P 500” is used only to name the index; Vennett is not affiliated with S&P Dow Jones Indices.
legal_terms_account_age: For people over 14 with a valid email and their own player name. By signing up, you accept these terms and the
legal_terms_password: Keep your password safe; you can change it in
legal_terms_delete_account: You can close your account at any time from the same screen, instantly. Your data is deleted according to the privacy policy.
legal_terms_public_content: Your alias and the names of your strategies and leagues are visible to others and are moderated. We may hide content that violates these terms or suspend the account, and will notify you when possible.
legal_terms_display_content: You allow us to display that content and your strategy results within Vennett, and in the historical standings without your name if you close your account.
legal_terms_no_personal_data: Do not include personal data in phrases, names, or questions.
legal_terms_ai_text: Some features use AI to suggest rules or evaluate companies. It can be wrong, is labeled as AI, and is not a recommendation. It is optional; when you use it, your text is sent to the provider described in the
legal_terms_credits: AI features have monthly limits per account. There is no balance or credits to buy.
legal_terms_acceptable_use_text: Do not impersonate other people or the house, use offensive or illegal names, manipulate standings or overload the service, or present a strategy as a real financial recommendation.
legal_terms_availability_text: Vennett is under development: we may change rules, scoring, or usage limits and interrupt the service. Market data comes from third parties and may be inaccurate or delayed. The service is provided “as is,” and simulations are not equivalent to real investing (they exclude fees and taxes). This does not limit your consumer rights.
legal_terms_changes_law_text: If we make a material change to these terms, we will notify you in the app before it takes effect; if you disagree, you can close your account. Spanish law applies, and if you are a consumer, you may bring a claim in the courts where you live.
legal_privacy_summary_1: We store what is needed to play: email, player name, strategies and usage limits.
legal_privacy_summary_2: No advertising or third-party tracking. We record your account activity. We do not sell or share your data.
legal_privacy_summary_3: AI is optional. If you use it, the text you write is sent to a provider (DeepSeek in China; Jev in the U.S.), never your email.
legal_privacy_summary_4: Download your data or delete your account instantly from Your account.
legal_privacy_summary_5: We charge nothing: there are no payments in the app. If you have a purchase from before October 2026, Lemon Squeezy processes its payment data as an independent controller.
legal_privacy_account_data: email, password if you have one (stored encrypted), sign-up and access dates, and technical data about your sessions, which is logged for security. If you sign in with Google, Google also shares your name with us.
legal_privacy_profile_data: an alias different from your real name, which is the only name others see; your age in years, which we use to check the minimum age and the annual prize; your light or dark theme and, if you choose one, your language. Your email is not shown to anyone.
legal_privacy_created_content_data: the name and crest of your strategies, their rules, the phrase describing them, your drafts, your yes-or-no question, their results, and the names of your private leagues.
legal_privacy_account_visits_data: a log of access and activity, including the results you review, for security and to run the service. It does not add tracking cookies.
legal_privacy_credits_plan_data: monthly AI feature usage per account.
legal_privacy_purchases_data: a record of purchases before October 2026: what you bought, dates, status and Lemon identifier. Lemon stores payment data and invoices.
legal_privacy_ai_usage_data: the purpose, model, tokens, cost, and whether it failed; not the contents of your phrase or the response.
legal_privacy_reports_errors_data: the reason for a report; for an error notice, the screen, a code, your optional note, and minimal technical data.
legal_privacy_records_data: which legal documents you accepted and when, and an internal record of important actions on your account.
legal_privacy_not_collected: We do not ask for your real name, phone number, address, date of birth or location. If you have a purchase from before October 2026, Lemon Squeezy processes its payment data (see below).
legal_privacy_purpose_basis: Why and on what legal basis
legal_privacy_service_basis: account, strategies, standings and usage limits, draft recovery and results tracking.
legal_privacy_payments_basis: handling purchases before October 2026 case by case.
legal_privacy_security_basis: usage limits, abuse prevention, moderation of public names and text, and internal audits of account access. You may object (see
legal_privacy_ai_basis: by pressing the button, you consent to sending that text to the provider listed below.
legal_privacy_legal_basis: when required by a competent authority.
legal_privacy_ai_optional: AI is optional; you can play using only catalog rules. Data sent:
legal_privacy_ai_deepseek: Your phrase (“Describe it in your own words”) → DeepSeek (China).
legal_privacy_ai_jev: Your yes-or-no question → Jev, by TypeSafe AI (United States), together with public data about the company. Jev is a processor under the EU standard contractual clauses and does not train its models on the data it receives.
legal_privacy_ai_readings_moderation: In-depth readings use only public company data. Names are moderated using a word list and human review.
legal_privacy_deepseek_transfer: DeepSeek processes data in China, outside GDPR protection, and does not offer standard contractual clauses; according to its policy, it may use data to improve its services. For that reason it is used only with your explicit consent (GDPR Art. 49(1)(a)), given when you press the button. Do not include personal data in the phrase or question.
legal_privacy_automated_decisions: We do not make decisions about you based solely on automated processing. AI makes suggestions and you decide; its results are labeled as AI-generated.
legal_privacy_processors: Who else can see your data
legal_privacy_processors_intro: We do not sell or share your data. These processors handle it on our behalf (GDPR Art. 28):
legal_privacy_processor_db: Supabase: database and accounts, hosted in the EU.
legal_privacy_processor_web: Vercel: hosts the website and sees your IP when you visit.
legal_privacy_processor_correo: Resend (a United States company) delivers the access emails: your address and the link to confirm your account or change your password. It acts as a processor on our behalf.
legal_privacy_processor_lemon: Only for purchases before October 2026, Lemon Squeezy (United States) processes payment data as an independent controller under its own privacy policy. It shares the purchase record, dates and status with us.
legal_privacy_transfers_outside_eu: Some of these providers are headquartered in the United States. If data leaves the EU, it is protected by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.
legal_privacy_retention_account: Your account data while your account exists. When you delete it, your email, profile, usage limits, evidence and consents are deleted.
legal_privacy_retention_purchases: If you have a purchase from before October 2026, Lemon keeps payment data and invoices for as long as the law requires. We retain a record of that purchase.
legal_privacy_retention_strategies: Strategies that have played remain in historical standings as “Retired strategy,” without your alias or rules and are not played again.
legal_privacy_retention_reports: Reports and error notices are retained without your identifier; the internal log keeps an internal number without a name or email.
legal_privacy_retention_logs: Technical server logs are retained for the period set by each provider.
legal_privacy_retention_backups: Backups may retain your data for a time after account closure; if a backup is restored, already deleted accounts are not recovered.
legal_privacy_rights_intro: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, portability, and withdrawal of consent. From
legal_privacy_rights_account_actions: , instantly: download your data (JSON), change your name and password, and delete your account (you must provide your player name and password; deletion cannot be undone). For anything else, write to
legal_privacy_rights_authority: You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).
legal_privacy_security_minors_text: Connections are encrypted, and the database only lets each person read their own data. Vennett is for people over 14 (Art. 7 of Spanish Organic Law 3/2018).
legal_privacy_changes_text: If anything important changes, we will tell you in the app before it takes effect. The date and version above identify the current policy.
legal_cookies_summary_1: We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies. We do use functional cookies to remember the language you chose.
legal_cookies_summary_2: Your session is stored in the browser's local storage; language cookies last one year.
legal_cookies_summary_3: There is no analytics or advertising, and no consent switch for these necessary functions.
legal_cookies_browser_storage: What we store in your browser
legal_cookies_session_purpose: Keeps you signed in. This is necessary for the service you request, so it does not require your consent.
legal_cookies_session_duration: Until you sign out or clear site data.
legal_cookies_locale_purpose: Explicit language preference from your profile or visitor choice. It is functional and lets us show the interface in your selected language.
legal_cookies_visitor_purpose: Language preference chosen by a signed-out visitor. When they sign in, it is saved to the account and this cookie is deleted.
legal_cookies_changes_text: Cloudflare Turnstile verification during sign-up and newsletter registration may store technical Cloudflare cookies. If anything else changes, this page will be updated beforehand.
legal_cookies_privacy_more: Learn more about your data in the
legal_terms_past_payments: If you purchased a paid plan or a pass before October 2026, write to our terms contact and we will resolve it case by case.
legal_terms_blog: The newsletter publishes lessons to help you understand companies and strategies. They are educational content, not investment recommendations. Subscribing is optional: only those who confirm receive emails, and they can unsubscribe with one click.
meta_legal_bases_descripcion: Requirements, calculation, amounts and payment of Vennett's annual prize.
legal_bases_resumen_1: Entering is free: you pay nothing to enter or to collect.
legal_bases_resumen_2: Only people aged 18 or over can take part.
legal_bases_resumen_3: The prize is worked out when each season closes and is only paid if there are enough accounts.
legal_bases_resumen_4: Prizes are capital gains for income tax in Spain (IRPF).
legal_bases_organiza: Vennett organises the prize. The site owner is listed in the legal notice.
legal_bases_quien_1: People who declare they are 18 or over in their account before the season closes.
legal_bases_quien_2: Each account competes with one strategy, the one it designates for the prize. A change counts from the next round that is formed.
legal_bases_quien_3: You need to have played at least 10 rounds in the season.
legal_bases_quien_4: House strategies (Alpha, Omega and Lambda) do not compete for the prize.
legal_bases_calculo_1: There is no draw: the result comes from the return of your paper strategy, compounded round by round. A round not played counts as 0%.
legal_bases_calculo_2: Eligible accounts are ranked by cumulative return when the season closes.
legal_bases_calculo_3: In a tie, the tied places add their prizes and split them equally, rounded down to the cent.
legal_bases_activacion_1: With 100 eligible accounts, the first tier is paid. With 250 or more, the full tier.
legal_bases_activacion_2: With fewer than 100 eligible accounts there is no prize that season.
legal_bases_importes_1: First tier: €150, €75 and €25 for the top three places.
legal_bases_importes_2: Full tier: €300, €150 and €50 for the top three places.
legal_bases_importes_3: The amounts do not depend on what anyone pays.
legal_bases_pago_1: We pay by bank transfer to an account in the winner's name, after verifying their identity.
legal_bases_pago_2: We will email the address on your account to ask for the details we need.
legal_bases_impuestos_1: The prize is a capital gain for IRPF. We do not withhold tax on prizes of up to €300.
legal_bases_impuestos_2: If the law requires us to report the prize to the Spanish tax office, we will. Your income tax return is your responsibility: check with your tax adviser.
legal_bases_datos_1: We use your username, your email and any identity details we ask for only to calculate and pay the prize, as set out in the privacy policy.
legal_bases_cambios_1: We may change these rules. Changes are published on this page.
legal_terms_summaries: We may email you a summary of your strategies and your position in the leagues. You can turn this off in Your account, Notifications.
legal_privacy_processor_turnstile: Cloudflare Turnstile: anti-bot verification during sign-up, recovery and newsletter registration. It sees your IP and browser data.
legal_privacy_newsletter_data: email, language, sign-up, confirmation and unsubscribe dates, and the outcome of each email sent.
legal_privacy_newsletter_basis: sending you the lessons you requested, with your consent when you confirm. You can unsubscribe with one click from each email.
legal_privacy_summaries_data: your strategy results and your league position, which we already process.
legal_privacy_summaries_basis: sending summaries of your strategies and league position as part of the service. You can turn them off in Your account, Notifications.
legal_privacy_antibot_data: IP and browser data processed by Cloudflare Turnstile during sign-up, recovery and newsletter registration to prevent abuse.
legal_privacy_retention_newsletter: Unconfirmed newsletter registrations are deleted after 7 days; confirmed subscribers are retained until they unsubscribe.
